public.text: Countries are told to adopt registries in a sequence suited to their priorities, but no method is provided for managing inconsistent identifiers and source lists during the transition.
public.suggestedRevision: Add transition guidance covering source-system inventory, temporary crosswalks, canonical identifier assignment, duplicate resolution, data-quality remediation, phased onboarding, coexistence, and retirement of local master lists.
